watches.name: Luffy ST26-005 SP
watches._min_price_note: ST26-005 covers both the cheap base card and the SP. Observed: base raws $2-30 and base PSA 10 slabs $120-270; genuine SP raws start at $396 and SP PSA 10s at $1,100. 300 drops both junk clusters without excluding any real SP listing.

watches.name: Luffy OP05-119 SEC (Alt / Manga Art)
watches._min_price_note: OP05-119 also matches cheap non-SEC printings. Observed a tight junk cluster at $10-75 (21 of 39 raws), with legitimate copies from $100 up. Raise this if base cards still slip through.

watches.name: Giratina V Alt Art 186/196 (Lost Origin)
watches._note: Pokemon. Identify by number 186/196 (normalizes to '186196'): a contiguous substring unique to this card — the regular V is 130/196, and every Giratina VSTAR is 131/201/212. Require the bare name 'giratina' (NOT 'giratina v', whose norm 'giratinav' is a prefix of 'giratinavstar') + '186/196'; also exclude 'vstar' belt-and-suspenders. Excludes anchored ('cards lot' not bare 'lot', which would drop 'Holo TCG'->'holotcg'). Verified offline: 12/12 real titles matched, 14/14 confusables (regular V 130, VSTAR 131/201/212, Full Art 185/196, jumbo, master set/ETB/booster box, Japanese) rejected.
queries: giratina v alt art 186/196 lost origin
giratina v alternate full art 186/196 lost origin
watches._exclude_note: sealed/bulk/lot terms are now handled centrally by is_bulk_or_sealed(); only the card-specific 'vstar' (keeps out Giratina VSTAR) remains here.
watches._language_note: language 'any': the English 186/196 number is unique to the English set (Japanese alt art is 111/100), so the number gates language and 'english' would drop legit 'English not Japanese' titles.

watches.name: Mew ex 232/091 SIR (Paldean Fates)
watches._note: Pokemon. 232/091 is the Special Illustration Rare 'Bubble Mew'; the only sibling in the set is Mew ex 216/091 (Shiny UR), excluded by number (both 216/091 and 216/91 spellings). match_any also handles the common '232/91' leading-zero form (normalizes to '23291', distinct from '232091'), a bare '#232'+set+SIR path, and a numberless 'bubble mew'+set path. Require 'mew ex' not bare 'mew' (which substring-hits 'mewtwo', also excluded). Verified offline: 13/13 real titles matched, 13/13 confusables (216/091 both forms, Mewtwo, 151-set Mew ex 205/165 & 193/165, bulk/master-set/jumbo/sealed, Japanese 347/190) rejected.

watches.name: Rayquaza V Alt Art 194/203 (Evolving Skies)
watches._note: Pokemon. Identify by number 194/203 ('194203', unique to the V alt art) — NOT by 'rayquaza v', whose norm 'rayquazav' is a prefix of 'rayquazavmax'. The number cleanly separates it from the (also famous) Rayquaza VMAX Alt Art 218/203, the regular V 110/203, VMAX 111/203, and gold VMAX 217/203, so no 'vmax' exclude is needed (which would wrongly drop 'not VMAX' clarification listings). Verified offline: 9/9 real titles matched, 10/10 confusables (VMAX alt 218, regular V/VMAX, gold VMAX, VSTAR, sealed/jumbo/lot, extended-art case, other-Eeveelution alt art) rejected.

watches.name: Rayquaza 3/17 Holo (POP Series 1)
watches._note: Pokemon vintage (2004 POP Series 1 promo, Cosmos Holo Rare). Identify by number 3/17 + the set (pop series / pop 1). 3/17 normalizes to '317', a short substring that collides with e.g. 13/17 ('1317') and 3/170 ('3170'), so pairing with 'pop series' is required for precision. 3/17 IS inherently the holo card (no non-holo print), so we don't require the word 'holo' (which would also match 'non-holo' via substring and hurt recall) — instead we exclude 'non holo' to drop any mislabels. Verified offline: 7/7 real titles matched (incl. terse + PSA 10), 5/5 confusables (non-holo, 13/17, 3/170, Charizard 3/17, proxy) rejected. NOTE: PSA 8/9 (common for vintage) classify as other_graded and won't alert under the house grade set.
queries: rayquaza 3/17 holo rare pop series 1 promo
